facts.fact: The bond ends on day 35 when the Meadow Cairn's meltwater runs; Shilak's thaw comes on day 48, and the queen arrives three days later.
facts.why: needed because the beat sets the bond's end before the Shilak council and the chapter must place both.

facts.fact: Ila adds a second unit to the Shared Map's scale bar: the rope (eight spans of the guide's arm) beside crown spans; her recalibrated pace is one and three-quarter spans.
facts.why: needed because the beat has her take a new unit after losing two toes.

facts.fact: The previously unnamed crag east of the Drum, above the fold where Dhanu laid his nets, is Dhanu's Rest, written in the hill hand; Nimmi's Knuckle remains only in Ila's field book, the map using Widow's Knuckle.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Kunal give her one nameless crag to name.

facts.fact: Gauri sends word by a boy that the hamlet old women voted to put the Widow's Ladder on the map.
facts.why: needed because the beat says the hamlets want it known.

facts.fact: The queen says she read Harish's name on a list at nineteen and never dared ask the archive what came after; her anger at Ila's broken oath is stated but no penalty is set.
facts.why: needed to show the queen's private voice and anger without adding plot.

facts.fact: Roop guides Old Bhim and Chand guides a terrace woman across the Long Saddle to the council.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Meera's crew guide the delegates.
